data.body_html:
Choosing between the Mangusta 80 vs Pershing 46 vs Sunseeker Predator 55 for a Marbella charter can be tricky. Each yacht offers a distinct experience, from the spacious maxi-rib Mangusta 80 to the sporty Pershing 46 and the iconic Sunseeker Predator 55. In this comparison, we break down specs, pricing, and best use cases so you can decide which boat suits your group, budget, and cruising style from Puerto Banús.

Mangusta 80: The Spacious Maxi-Rib with a Jet Ski

The Mangusta 80 is a 24-metre maxi-rib that can carry up to 12 guests. It departs from Puerto Banús and is known for its massive deck space, comfortable seating, and a free jet ski included on charters of 4 hours or more. The price is fixed at €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter, covering skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. This makes it ideal for groups who want to combine cruising with water sports. The Mangusta 80 is available in two colour variants (white and grey), both identical in spec.

Pershing 46: Sporty Performance and Sleek Design

The Pershing 46 is a 14-metre sport yacht, accommodating up to 10 guests. It also departs from Puerto Banús and is designed for speed and agility, with a top speed exceeding 40 knots. Pricing for the Pershing 46 is on request – contact us via WhatsApp for a quote. It comes with the same inclusions as all our charters: skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. The Pershing 46 is a great choice for smaller groups who value performance and style over sheer deck space.

Sunseeker Predator 55: The Benchmark Competitor

The Sunseeker Predator 55 is a 16.8-metre luxury motor yacht, popular in Marbella for its aggressive lines and spacious cockpit. However, it is not in our fleet. We compare it to give you context. The Predator 55 typically accommodates 10-12 guests and has a similar price bracket to the Mangusta 80. If you are considering a Predator 55, our Mangusta 80 offers more deck space and a free jet ski, while our Pershing 46 delivers a sportier ride. For a direct alternative, the Mangusta 80 is our closest match.

Which Boat is Best for Your Group?

For groups of 10-12 guests who want space and water toys, the Mangusta 80 is unbeatable. Its 24m deck and free jet ski make it perfect for a day of sunbathing and water sports. For smaller groups (up to 10) who prioritise speed and a sporty feel, the Pershing 46 is the better choice. If you were considering a Sunseeker Predator 55, the Mangusta 80 offers a similar luxury experience with more included value. All charters depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's premier marina.

Pricing and Inclusions

Our charter prices are transparent. The Mangusta 80 is fixed at €4,719 for 4 hours (includes jet ski). The Pershing 46 is priced on request – message us on WhatsApp for a quote. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees. For other boats in our fleet, such as the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 58 Flybridge, pricing is also on request.

Where to Cruise in Marbella

From Puerto Banús, you can cruise to Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, or along the Golden Mile. The Mangusta 80’s shallow draft allows close access to coves, while the Pershing 46’s speed lets you reach Estepona or Sotogrande quickly. Both boats offer stunning views of La Concha mountain. For a full day, consider a 6-hour charter to explore more of the Costa del Sol coastline.
